Subject: Rent Payment and Access to Funds  

Grant,  

I want to redirect this back to the main issue. The immediate priority is that rent needs to be paid. The payment was returned, and funds must be placed into the Bank of America account from which rent is routinely drafted so the bank can redeposit it.  

I currently have zero access to our jointly held accounts or mutual funds. Regardless of what has been discussed in the proposed MDA, it is not final or executed. We are still legally married, and shared financial obligations remain in effect until a final agreement is entered and signed.  

This is not about future allocations or draft terms. It is about ensuring that an essential, ongoing obligation is paid on time.  

Please confirm when the appropriate funds have been deposited into the correct account so this can be resolved immediately.  

Bethany

Subject: Immediate Action Required Regarding Joint Funds  

Grant,  

I am formally requesting that you provide me with access to our jointly held cryptocurrency account, which is currently under your sole control. At a minimum, our mutual funds need to be transferred into the Bank of America account, which presently has a balance of $9.13.  

In good faith, I have continued transferring my paychecks to you every other week, retaining only what is necessary for food for Donivan and me, with the understanding that these funds would be applied toward our joint financial obligations. Those obligations have not been paid from our account, which raises serious concerns regarding the handling of these funds.  

The recent medical expenses related to my spinal injury were paid from our other Bank of America account. Any remaining accessible joint funds should be applied toward our shared bills.  

As of today, my rent check has been returned for insufficient funds. Credit card payments have also been declined. We remain legally married, and our shared financial obligations are still in effect. The $3,000 per month in ongoing support has been allocated specifically for rent. These funds must be deposited into the Bank of America account by tomorrow so the bank may attempt to redeposit the check.  

All accounts you previously requested be transferred into my name have been moved accordingly or canceled when I was financially unable to maintain them. Despite this, I am still remitting the entirety of my available income to you. Requiring this while failing to apply joint funds toward shared obligations is neither reasonable nor consistent with your financial and legal responsibilities.  

Additionally, the attorney we originally retained to handle our divorce must be paid. Continued coordination with your new counsel, along with delays in standard proceedings, has resulted in additional hourly legal fees. These fees have arisen due to the need to address compliance with agreed financial responsibilities. The current invoice is attached and may be paid via Zelle.  

Your unilateral control of jointly held assets, refusal to provide access, and failure to apply shared funds toward agreed obligations may be considered financially obstructive and inconsistent with your legal duties regarding marital property and liabilities.  

If you are unwilling to provide direct access to the account, you must immediately withdraw the necessary funds and transfer them into the Bank of America account so that rent and other mutual obligations can be satisfied without further disruption.  

Please resolve this matter tonight to prevent additional legal and financial consequences. We are nearing the final stages of this process. However, if these issues persist, I will instruct my attorney to prepare and file the appropriate complaint with the court to ensure enforcement of the terms outlined in the MDA once finalized. Any resulting legal fees will necessarily be addressed within the division of remaining marital assets.  

Bethany  

P.S. Gail, I did receive your unexpected letter today. It is clear to me that you may not be fully aware of the current financial circumstances. In the spirit of what you wrote regarding love and past situations, I would appreciate your assistance in encouraging Grant to resolve this matter promptly, as the continued withholding of joint funds directly impacts shared financial obligations.
